parent_task: T10 (stays blocked; this package does not close T10)
primary_goal: Return to the native PAXI boundary contract on top of b15: (1) convert AW/AR word index to native address {word_index[23:0],3'b000} only at the bridge output, with range check; (2) drive paxi_wstrb=0 (native full-word write) and make the simulation model actually enforce the mask; (3) default single-command acceptance (AW/W and AR mutually exclusive; keep ALLOW_CONCURRENT for later comparison); (4) update the model to check low3/out-of-range/mask/concurrency, run an 8-16 distinct-word write-stop-read test first, then full frame / two frames / drop-R and the P1 three goldens; (5) expand the status packet to v6 with last_issued_ar_addr, timeout-latched AR address+low3, AW/W/AR same-cycle flags and in-flight state; (6) rebuild with 0 routed violations and WNS per b13 rules, 1 bitgen + 1 CWC; (7) download once then open COM8 for 150 s and require timeout/retry/giveup deltas zero, enc/exported deltas >0 and at least one frame with four CRCs + zlib; if R is still missing, preserve v6 failure-AR evidence and stop.
protected: all other run dirs/manifests/evidence, all bit/CWC/BID/DB outside this package, TD drive mappings, Flash/program_spi, board/COM/JTAG/RK

gates.address_unit: AW/AR native address is exactly {word_index[23:0],3'b000}; internal slots remain 256-bit word units; 16-word test observes 0,8,...,120; every PAXI address low3=0; max valid word 424313; range check sticky + sim fatal.
gates.mask: paxi_wstrb is 32'h0000_0000 in the candidate; model bit=0 enables a byte, bit=1 preserves it; all-zero writes the full word, all-ones writes nothing; clean runs n_mask_nonzero=0; all-ones negative control proves no write.
gates.command_acceptance: ALLOW_CONCURRENT=0 in bitgen/board: no same-cycle AW+AR or W+AR handshake; write-start/AR arbitration is write-priority (`paxi_arvalid = rd_req && !wr_start_req`); model n_same_hs=0; ALLOW_CONCURRENT=1 is comparison-only and must not be used for the board candidate.
gates.small_pattern: 16 distinct 256-bit words written to internal indices 0..15, stop >=32 clk_ddr cycles, read back 16/16 byte-identical; model n_bad_low3=n_oob=n_mask_nonzero=n_same_req=n_same_hs=0; n_write_commit=16; last_issued_ar_addr=120.
gates.frame_sim: S1: pix_beats 2,117,472 / line_rises 2,192 / frame_rises 1 / crop_groups 518,400 / raw_len 2,592,000 / enc=1 / exported=1 / four CRCs + strict zlib / no half frame / timeout=retry=giveup=0 / ar=r=rlast=210,685 / model counters 0. S2: exported=2 / ar=r=rlast=421,370 / both frames four CRCs + zlib.
gates.drop_recovery: S3: exactly one timeout then one successful retry then exported=1 with golden CRC; giveup=0; late R only stale, never queued; dup=0; dropped AR native address low3=0.
gates.p1: micro8x2/mid64x8/full_grad compressed bytes SHA256 identical to b15 caps (FA513A2B.../EE61E620.../B992A8AD...); four CRCs; zlib_ok; dup=0; no half frame; vlog 0/0.
gates.v6: 273 B, 67 fields, VER=6, LEN low byte 0x11, XOR over 0..271; v5 241 B/59 fixture still parses; bad XOR rejected; fields 60..67 reflect bridge diagnostics and are all zero/low3=0 in clean runs.
gates.negative_controls: Frozen b15 bridge against b17 model must fail (address and mask violations); all-ones mask must not modify memory; low3/OOB/concurrency must be counted and must not hang; these are mandatory evidence, not optional.
gates.routed: 0 violations, hold >= 0, period positive, ERAM+CWC <=300; WNS target >= +0.05; if 0 violations and WNS in +0.003..+0.05, accept diagnostic candidate with timing_caveat=thin_margin_+0.00x; WNS < +0.003 or any violation stops the build.
gates.bitgen_cwc: 1 each; bit/CWC/BID/compiled hashes frozen and self-consistent.
gates.board: FTDI preflight; absent => board=blocked, 0 download, 0 COM8. Present => exactly 1 SRAM download FIRST, then COM8 150 s: >=120 valid v6 packets, bad_xor=0, len=273/ver=6/fields=67, sel=0/bit20=0, cap_frames and raw_pub deltas >0, crop_short=crop_geom_err=0, timeout=retry=giveup deltas all 0, enc_frames/exported deltas >0, >=1 frame four CRCs + zlib, no half frame, stale_guard delta 0, ar-rlast<=1, ar-r<=1, all last_issued_ar_addr low3=0, same_aw_ar_cnt=same_w_ar_cnt=0, diag_flags bits1..5=0.

notes: Parent T10 remains blocked; this package does not close T10. The candidate keeps the b15 read strictness and fixes the native PAXI boundary only: address x8, mask=0, single-command acceptance. ALLOW_CONCURRENT=1 is comparison-only. v6 expands the status packet to 273 B/67 fields; frame format and all 7 other RTL files stay frozen. Path contract: Y:=project root, T:=r0/td, P:=project root, W:=r0/sim, X: never maps to project root. No Flash, no PCIe/RK, no dual-A+/G4, no batch delete. T10.b17 is the only formal package; the tester is a new independent integrated tester after the candidate is frozen.
